title: Fix Comment Section — Add/Reply/Like/Edit/Delete with Backend Persistence

requirements.text: Define a Comment data type in the backend with fields: id (Nat), postId (Text), authorId (Principal), content (Text), createdAt (Int), updatedAt (opt Int), parentCommentId (opt Nat), likes (array of Principal), isDeleted (Bool). Store comments in a stable var array or HashMap keyed by comment id.
acceptanceCriteria: Comment type is defined with all required fields including parentCommentId for nesting and likes array.
Comments persist across canister upgrades via stable storage.

requirements.text: Implement the following backend query and update functions for comments: addComment(postId: Text, content: Text, parentCommentId: ?Nat) returns new comment id; getCommentsByPost(postId: Text) returns array of all non-deleted comments for that post; editComment(commentId: Nat, newContent: Text) allows only the comment author to update content; deleteComment(commentId: Nat) marks the comment as deleted (soft delete) only if caller is the author; likeComment(commentId: Nat) toggles the caller's Principal in the comment's likes array; getCommentLikeCount(commentId: Nat) returns the like count.
acceptanceCriteria: addComment correctly associates a comment with the given postId and sets parentCommentId when replying.
getCommentsByPost returns only non-deleted comments for the specified postId.
editComment rejects calls from non-authors with an error.
deleteComment soft-deletes the comment (isDeleted = true) and rejects non-author callers.
likeComment toggles the like — adds if not present, removes if already liked.
All functions require an authenticated caller (not anonymous principal).

requirements.text: Add React Query hooks in frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts for the comment system: useGetCommentsByPost(postId) fetches comments for a post; useMutationAddComment() calls addComment; useMutationEditComment() calls editComment; useMutationDeleteComment() calls deleteComment; useMutationLikeComment() calls likeComment. All mutation hooks must invalidate the useGetCommentsByPost query on success so comments refresh instantly without a page reload.

quotes: Show comments instantly after submission (no page refresh).

acceptanceCriteria: useGetCommentsByPost fetches and returns the comments array for a given postId.
All mutation hooks invalidate the comments query on success, causing an immediate re-fetch.
Hooks are exported and available for use in comment UI components.

requirements.text: Create a new frontend component frontend/src/components/CommentSection.tsx that renders the full comment UI for a given postId. The component must: display a list of comments showing the author's profile image (or a default avatar), username, relative timestamp (e.g., '2m ago'), and comment text; support nested replies rendered indented under their parent comment; show an input field to add a new top-level comment with a loading spinner while posting; show success and error toast messages after submission attempts; display a three-dot (⋮) context menu on each comment with 'Edit' and 'Delete' options visible only to the comment's author, and a 'Report' option visible to other authenticated users; support an inline reply input triggered per-comment; support inline edit mode replacing comment text with an editable input; show like button with count on each comment; use the React Query hooks from REQ-3 for all data operations.

quotes: Show comments instantly after submission (no page refresh).
Comments should display: User profile image, Username, Time (e.g., 2m ago), Edit / Delete / Report options (based on permissions)

acceptanceCriteria: Comments for a post load and display on mount without a page refresh.
Submitting a new comment shows a loading indicator and the comment appears in the list immediately after success.
Replies are indented under their parent comment.
A toast or inline message is shown on both success and error for add/edit/delete/like actions.
The three-dot menu shows Edit and Delete only when the logged-in user is the comment author.
The three-dot menu shows Report to users who are not the author.
Clicking Edit replaces the comment text with an editable input field.
Clicking Delete removes the comment from the list after confirmation.
Like button toggles correctly and displays the current like count.
Each comment shows the author's avatar (profile photo or default), username, and relative time.

requirements.text: Integrate the CommentSection component into the PostCard component (frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx). Add a collapsible comment section below each post that is shown/hidden when the user clicks a 'Comment' button or icon. Pass the post's id as the postId prop to CommentSection.
acceptanceCriteria: Each PostCard displays a comment toggle button.
Clicking the toggle reveals the CommentSection for that specific post.
CommentSection is not rendered (or is hidden) by default to avoid unnecessary backend calls.
The correct postId is passed to CommentSection so comments are scoped to the post.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not break existing post, like, poll, group, or page functionality.
Only the comment author may edit or delete their own comment — enforce this on both frontend (hide options) and backend (reject unauthorized calls).
Use soft delete (isDeleted flag) for comments rather than hard deletion to preserve reply thread integrity.
nonGoals: Poll results visibility fix — out of scope for this request.
Three-dot menu for posts (edit/delete/report on posts) — out of scope for this request.
Admin panel reporting integration — out of scope for this request.
Location/constituency fields on posts — out of scope for this request.
Real-time comment updates via WebSocket — not supported on this platform.
